text: For 2020 actual, room revenue was $3,266,750, food and beverage revenue was $1,120,000, other revenue was $210,000, total revenue was $4,596,750, departmental expense was $1,925,025, undistributed expense was $1,150,000, gross operating profit was $1,521,725, and reported RevPAR was $89.50.
For 2020 actual, the synthetic hotel had 100 rooms, operated 365 days, offered 36,500 available room nights, sold 26,280 room nights, reported 72.00% occupancy, and reported ADR of $124.31.
